(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((objs (objects-multicolor g 0))
                  (nz (filter (lambda (p) (!= (third p) 0)) (grid-cells g)))
                  (t-order (list 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7)))
             (define (orth-neighbor? r c)
               (any? (lambda (d)
                       (let ((rr (+ r (first d)))
                             (cc (+ c (second d))))
                         (and (in-bounds? rr cc h w) (!= (at g rr cc) 0))))
                     (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1))))
             (define (source? o)
               (any? (lambda (p) (orth-neighbor? (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells o)))
             (define sources (filter source? objs))
             (define markers
               (filter (lambda (p) (not (orth-neighbor? (first p) (second p)))) nz))
             (define (local-valued obj)
               (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
                      (r0 (first bb))
                      (c0 (second bb)))
                 (map (lambda (p)
                        (list (- (first p) r0)
                              (- (second p) c0)
                              (at g (first p) (second p))))
                      (obj-cells obj))))
             (define (mapped t r c)
               (cond
                 ((zero? t) (list r c))
                 ((= t 1) (list r (- 0 c)))
                 ((= t 2) (list (- 0 r) c))
                 ((= t 3) (list (- 0 r) (- 0 c)))
                 ((= t 4) (list c r))
                 ((= t 5) (list c (- 0 r)))
                 ((= t 6) (list (- 0 c) r))
                 (else (list (- 0 c) (- 0 r)))))
             (define (transform-cells cells t)
               (let* ((raw (map (lambda (cell)
                                  (let ((p (mapped t (first cell) (second cell))))
                                    (list (first p) (second p) (third cell))))
                                cells))
                      (mr (min-of first raw))
                      (mc (min-of second raw)))
                 (map (lambda (cell)
                        (list (- (first cell) mr) (- (second cell) mc) (third cell)))
                      raw)))
             (define (marker-at? r c v)
               (not (null? (filter (lambda (m)
                                     (and
                                       (= (first m) r)
                                       (= (second m) c)
                                       (= (third m) v)))
                                   markers))))
             (define (in-bounds-cells? tr tc cells)
               (all? (lambda (cell)
                       (let ((r (+ tr (first cell)))
                             (c (+ tc (second cell))))
                         (and (>= r 0) (< r h) (>= c 0) (< c w))))
                     cells))
             (define (valid? tr tc specs cells)
               (and
                 (in-bounds-cells? tr tc cells)
                 (all? (lambda (sp)
                         (marker-at? (+ tr (first sp)) (+ tc (second sp)) (third sp)))
                       specs)))
             (define (candidate obj)
               (let* ((base (local-valued obj))
                      (main (mode-list (map third base)))
                      (cands (flatmap (lambda (t)
                                        (let* ((tcells (transform-cells base t))
                                               (specs (filter (lambda (cell)
                                                                (!= (third cell) main))
                                                              tcells)))
                                          (filter (lambda (cand)
                                                    (valid? (first cand)
                                                            (second cand)
                                                            specs
                                                            tcells))
                                                  (flatmap (lambda (sp)
                                                             (map (lambda (m)
                                                                    (list (- (first m)
                                                                             (first sp))
                                                                          (- (second m)
                                                                             (second sp))
                                                                          tcells))
                                                                  (filter (lambda (m)
                                                                            (= (third m)
                                                                               (third sp)))
                                                                          markers)))
                                                           specs))))
                                      t-order)))
                 (first cands)))
             (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
                       (let ((cand (candidate obj)))
                         (stamp-normalized-cells acc
                                                 (third cand)
                                                 (first cand)
                                                 (second cand))))
                     (cellmap g (r c v) 0)
                     sources)))))
